title: Seacrest Beach "Tranquillity Sea La Vie" 8600 E. County Highway 30A 240
h1: Seacrest Beach "Tranquillity Sea La Vie" 8600 E. County Highway 30A 240
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Beach front- Amazing gulf views- Professionally decorated- Community Pool heated from October to April- Balcony- 3 Adult bikes- Guests have access to the owners' beach chair closet- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Beautifully renovated home with incredible beach views! Tranquillity Sea La Vie is a fantastic 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom Seacrest Beach condo in a gated community, sleeping up to 6. White shiplap walls, floor-to-ceiling Gulf views, pale floors, and high-end finishes create a luxurious 30A coastal retreat unlike any other. Spend sun-soaked Florida days strolling the soft sands, splashing around the community pool with the kids, or biking the scenic Timpoochee Trail. Beach access is only steps away!Take the elevator up to the second floor and step inside this breathtaking coastal haven, where 2 comfortable guest bedrooms with king-sized beds welcome guests to the entryway and set the tone for a relaxing getaway. A short hallway leads to incredible Gulf views that can be enjoyed from the open living, kitchen, and dining spaces. Sink into the luxurious chaise lounge sectional and 2 stylish swivel chairs to enjoy a family movie night on the TV or simply unwind after a day at the beach. The adjoining dining area seats 6 and enjoys Emerald Coast views through the large windows and sliding glass doors that stretch across the living area and open onto the private balcony. Here, a small table and 4 chairs provide the perfect place to begin the day with a cup of coffee, watching dolphins play in the waves, or enjoying the warmth of the early morning sunrise. Friends and family will discover everything necessary to prepare delicious meals or whip up beachside snacks in the sleek chef’s kitchen, featuring white quartz countertops and a waterfall counter that comfortably seats 4 for breakfast and quick bites. When it's time to retire, the spacious primary bedroom offers a luxurious king bed, private bathroom with a shower, a walk-in closet, and a sliding glass door with plantation shutters that lead directly to the balcony. For added convenience, a full-sized washer and dryer are thoughtfully tucked away in the shared main bathroom.Tranquillity Sea La Vie is a gorgeous Gulf-front condo with unparalleled beach access. On-site parking for 1 vehicle with additional parking across the street and 3 complimentary adult bikes makes it easy to explore Seacrest Beach—plus nearby Rosemary and Alys Beach for added entertainment. For beach access, simply take the dedicated dune walkover or enjoy a quick 1-minute bike ride to Seacrest Drive Beach Access. Book today!*No pets are allowed on this property per the HOA rules.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 6):FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the Property, forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and Callista Vacation Rentals fines.*No Pets are Allowed on the Property per the HOA rules.
